## Checklist

- [ ] File lives in `themes/<slug>.json`
- [ ] Slug is unique (no other file in `themes/` with the same name)
- [ ] `name`, `colors`, and `version` are present
- [ ] `colors` includes all 5 keys: `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `surface`, `text`
- [ ] Every color is a 6- or 8-digit hex string (`#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`)
- [ ] Not a duplicate of GhostHub's built-in presets
- [ ] Previewed it on the gallery locally (`sprag dev static`) — colors look as intended
- [ ] Pasted the **Copy** output into GhostHub's theme builder to confirm it imports cleanly
